install_output_empty: Akukho mphumela okwanje. Imigqa yetheminali evela ethuluzini lokufaka izokuvela lapha.
linux_setup_title: I-Linux Flash & SP Flash Tool Setup
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Ukudawuniloda nokuhlela injini ephazima ngebelo elikhulu ukwenzela bona ukwazi ukubuyisela nokubuyekeza umdlali wakho ngaphandle kobudisi.
linux_card_engine_desc: Ithulusi lokukhanya le-MediaTek elinokuvumelana kwelayibhrari yendawo yoke.
linux_card_usb_desc: Inikela imvumo yedeskithophu yokuthintana nomdlali ngemodi ye-Bootloader.
system_checker_title: I-SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Ukuqinisekiswa okupheleleko kwabatjhayeli, amamojula we-kernel, iimvume, kanye namalayibhrari wesikhathi sokusebenza ukuqinisekisa ukukhanya okuthembekileko.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Yenza bona ikhomphyutha yakho ilungele ukuxhuma nomdlali wakho ukuthola iimbuyekezo zesofthiwe.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Ihlola ukusethwa kwe-Linux okuthuthukisiweko kwe-SP Flash Tool, ukufinyelela kwe-USB, iimvume ze-serial, kanye neengcenye zesistimu.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Yenza ikhomphyutha yakho ilungele ukuxhumana nomdlali wakho begodu ifake iinbuyekezo zesofthiwe ngokuthembekileko.
settings_checker_desc: Yenza ikhomphyutha yakho ilungele ukuxhumana nomdlali wakho begodu ifake iinbuyekezo zesofthiwe ngokuthembekileko.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Ikhomphyutha yakho ilungele ukuxhumana nomdlali wakho.
linux_prep_blocked: Ikhomphyutha le ayikwazi ukusebenzisa i-SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Iphasiwedi yakho iyatlhogeka kanye ukuhlela ikhomphyutha le bona ikhanyise: imithetho ye-USB yamadivayisi we-MediaTek nokufinyelela kwe-serial port.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Ukusetha ikhomphyutha le nge-SP Flash Tool, iphasiwedi yakho izokutlhogeka esinyathelweni esilandelako ukuhlela imithetho ye-USB begodu ufake i-akhawunti yakho emaqenjini wabasebenzisi abatlhogekako. Nawungavumi, isibawo sizokuvalwa.
linux_prep_fixed: Ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe, i-SP Flash Tool ilungile.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Ukuhlela kuphelile begodu i-akhawunti yakho ifakwe emaqenjini wabasebenzisi atlhogekako we-SP Flash Tool. Sibawa uqalise kabutjha ikhomphyutha yakho ukwenzela bona iimvumo ezitjha zisebenze, bese uvula i-app godu. Tlika uphawu lokuhlola ukuvala i-app nje.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Kwenziwe, Vala i-App ukuqalisa kabutjha ikhomphyutha
settings_driver_desc: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-app kokuthoma, kufanele ufake umtjhayeli we-MediaTek USB, bese uqalisa kabutjha ikhomphyutha yakho.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Iimvume zokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelako kanye nesistimu yokusetha
home_desc: Thola i-firmware ku-inthanethi nofana ukhethe iphakheji yangekhenu, bese uyifaka kudivayisi yakho.
sel_source_desc: Landa i-firmware ku-inthanethi, nofana ungenise iphakheji yendawo.
settings_advanced_desc: Itjengisa indlela yokufaka, imodi yokufaka kanye namasefo wokukhipha.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: I-app ihlala nawe ngokucima, ukuxhuma, nokufaka.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ivala i-Updater bese ivula i-SP Flash Tool GUI ngefayela lokusakaza le-firmware elikhethiweko kanye neenthombe zokuhlukanisa ezifakwe ngaphambilini.
settings_terminal_desc: Yenza ukufakwa kwesofthiwe yakho kuTheminali ukwenzela bona ubone ilwazi lobuchwepheshe ngentuthuko.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Yenza ukufakwa kwesofthiwe yakho ku-Command Prompt ukwenzela bona ubone ilwazi lobuchwepheshe ngentuthuko.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Nokukhethwa. Amanye amathagethi we-MediaTek ayala ukukhanya bekube kulapho i-SP Flash Tool inikelwa ifayela lokuqinisekisa (.auth); engeza eyakho lapha nangabe idivayisi idinga enye.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Alikho ifayela lokusabalalisa elitholakele kuleli phakheji, njeke akukho umlayezo wekhonsoli owakhiwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Akukho SP Flash Tool build nofana i-MTKClient entry point etholakalako kilendlela.
terminal_install_failed: Akukghoni ukuvula ifasitela letheminali. Umyalo wokufaka utlolwe ku-{path}.
status_terminal_install: Umyalo wokufaka uvulwe ewindini lakho letheminali ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} manje izovula igijima {method}.

• Nangabe ingakavali, cima i-{device} yakho.
• Nangabe ixhunywe ku-USB, yivale qangi.
{hint}
• Xhuma idivayisi yakho nekhomphyutha yakho lokha ifasitela le-{terminal_name} nalivulekileko.

Chofoza Kulungile ukuqalisa nokuphuma ku-Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Isiyeleliso: Nangabe idivayisi ayixhumani ngokuzenzakalelayo, tjhayela ngobumnene inkinobho yokusetha kabutjha emgodini we-pinhole nge-paperclip lokha nawuhlanganisa ikheyibuli ye-USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Isiyeleliso: Faka idivayisi yakho kumodi yokudawuniloda i-firmware (iyahluka ngokuya ngemodeli: isib. susa ibhetri bese uyigcina ngaphandle ngekheyibuli ye-USB exhunyiwe, nofana uyivale ibhetri ifakwe, nofana ubambe iVolumu Phansi/Phezulu lokha nawuxhuma i-USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
I-SP Flash Tool GUI izokuvulwa nge-firmware yakho elayishwe ngaphambilini.

• Ku-SP Flash Tool, khetha "Landa" ebhokisini eliwela phasi.
• Chofoza inkinobho ethi "Landa".
• Qinisekisa bona i-{device} yakho ivaliwe begodu ivaliwe.
{hint}
• Xhuma ikheyibuli ye-USB kukhomphyutha yakho ngemva kokuchofoza ukulanda.

Chofoza Kulungile ukuvula i-SP Flash Tool bese uphuma ku-Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Lokha nayivunyelwe, iingqikithi ze-Rockbox zidluliselwa ngokuzenzakalelako ku-Y1 ne-Y2 ngemva kokufakwa kwe-Rockbox okuphumelelako.
themes_placement_failed_note: Asikwazanga ukubeka iphakheji yeengqikithi kumdlali wakho. Ungazama godu ukusuka kumaSethingi.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Tjengisa ukukhutjhwa kwesofthiwe yokuthoma okudala kune-3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Ukukhutjhwa kwesofthiwe yokuthoma endala kune-3.0.7 akukhambisani namayunithi we-Y1 athengiswa nge-Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ukukhanyisa ukwakhiwa okudala kumayunithi la kuzokwenza bona angaqali bekube kulapho kufakwa godu inguqulo etja.

Ingabe uyaqiniseka bona ufuna ukutjengisa ukukhutjhwa kwesofthiwe yokuthoma endala kune-3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Itjengisa ukwakhiwa okune-ROM zip engu-240p (rom…_240p.zip). Ukwakhiwa kwe-240p akukhambisani namayunithi we-Y1 ku-Innioasis OS ngaphasi kwe-3.0.7, njeke Tjengisa ukwakhiwa kwe-Rockbox endala kunikwe amandla kiyo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ukukhishwa kwe-Rockbox-Y1 ngaphambi kwe-0.5 akuhambisani namayunithi we-Y1 athengiswa ngemva kukaNtaka 2026 nge-Innioasis OS 3.0.7 efakwe ngaphambilini.

Ukukhanyisa ukwakhiwa okudala kumadivayisi la kuzokuvimbela ukuqalisa.

Uqinisekile bona ufuna ukutjengisa ukwakhiwa kwe-Rockbox okudala?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Sibawa ukhethe i-.zip, .rar archive, nofana i-scatter file (*scatter*.txt) ngaphakathi kwefolda ye-firmware ukufaka i-firmware oyikhethileko ku-{target} yakho.
sel_offline: Iinhlu eziku-inthanethi azitholakali njenganje. Sebenzisa ifayela lendawo, nofana uhlole ukuxhumana kwakho.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Amaphakheji amanengi we-firmware nofana amafayela we-scatter atholakala kule folda/i-archive. Sibawa ukhethe ifolda nofana i-archive enephakheji eyodwa ye-firmware ngesikhathi.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Ukukhishwa lokhu kuqukethe amafayela angaphezu kwelilodwa, njeke i-Updater angeze yakghona ukutjho bona umdlali wakho ufuna ukuhleleka. Umthuthukisi we-{software} uzokutlhoga ukubuyekeza ukukhishwa kwe-firmware yakhe ukufaka hlangana ifayela elilodwa lokusakaza.
sp_search_restart: Ayikho idivayisi okwanje, ngiyafuna godu (umzamo {count}). Gcina umdlali ucishiwe bese uwuxhuma lapho ucelwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Ifayela lokuqinisekisa alitholakali ({path}); ukukhanya ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Ifayela lokusakaza alimemezeli ipulatifomu yalo, ngalokho ukuhlelwa kwekhonsoli yefayela lokuqinisekisa akukwazanga ukwakhiwa; ukukhanya ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Ifayela lokuhlakazeka alimemezeli umhlobo wesitoreji (EMMC/NAND/UFS), ngalokho ukuhlelwa kwekhonsoli yefayela lokuqinisekisa akukwazanga ukwakhiwa; ukukhanya ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Alikho ifayela lokuqinisekisa elinikelweko; ukukhanya ngaphandle kweyodwa.
sp_config_write_failed: Angeze kwakghona ukutlola ifayela lokuhlela ikhonsoli; ukukhanya ngaphandle kwefayela lokuqinisekisa.
settings_notifications_desc: Tjengisa izaziso zesistimu zesaziso kanye nemihlobo yokubuyekeza ngezansi. I-Off igcina yoke into ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Uhlobo lubuyekezo lwe-hardware yomdlali. Abadlali bemodeli efanako bangakhiwa ngokubuyekezwa okungaphezu kokukodwa — isibonelo, i-Type A ne-Type B — begodu isofthiwe yenzelwe enye yazo. Hlola isitika ngemva komdlali; nangabe ayibizi umhlobo, tjhiya ukukhetha kokuthoma.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Azikho iinguqulo ezitholakalako zesofthiwe le njenganje.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Gcina i-app kubha yemenyu ngemva kokuthi ifasitela livale, ukwenzela bona usafumane izaziso zokubuyekezwa kwe-app ne-firmware yomdlali. Vala: ukuvala ifasitela kuyaphuma kuhlelo lokusebenza.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Gcina i-app ethreyini yesistimu ngemva kokuthi ifasitela livalwe, ukwenzela bona usafumane izaziso zokubuyekezwa kwe-app ne-firmware yomdlali. Vala: ukuvala ifasitela kuyaphuma kuhlelo lokusebenza.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Fihla ikhathalogu yomphakathi ye-inthanethi bese ufaka isofthiwe kumafayela wendawo kwaphela.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Ukhanyise ukwakhiwa kwe-Rockbox ye-360p. Ungathanda ukufaka i-360p Theme Pack kuledivayisi njenganje?
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Sibawa ukhuphe i-USB, uvule amandla bese uqalisa i-Rockbox kanye (ukobana ithome ifolda yayo yangaphakathi ye-.rockbox), bese uhlanganisa i-USB bese ukhetha 'Imodi yokuGcina ye-USB'.

Nawuxhunyiwe, chofoza i-Ragela phambili ukukhetha nanyana ngiyiphi ifolda kumdlali wakho.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Khetha nanyana ngiyiphi ifolda esitoreji somdlali wakho ohlanganisiweko
sel_themepack_success: I-Rockbox Theme Pack ifakwe kuhle kudivayisi yakho!
sel_only_local: Khetha iphakheji ye-firmware ye-.zip nofana ye-.rar, nofana ifayela lefolda / scatter .txt, ukufaka ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, akutlhogeki i-inthanethi. Isebenza kiyo yoke i-Innioasis ne-Timmkoo audio player.
sel_only_local_generic: Khetha iphakheji ye-firmware yangekhaya (.zip, .rar) nofana ifolda enefayela lokusabalalisa ukufaka ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, isebenza ngamadivayisi we-MediaTek ajwayelekileko.
sel_offline_install: Faka i-firmware ukusuka kufayela le-.zip nofana le-.rar kiyo nanyana ngiyiphi i-Innioasis nofana i-Timmkoo audio player.
sel_offline_install_generic: Faka i-firmware ukusuka ku-.zip/.rar archive nofana ifolda ye-firmware kumadivayisi we-MediaTek ajayelekileko.
conn_offline: Awukho ku-inthanethi. Ukufakwa okuvela ku-Community Firmware Archive akutholakali.
conn_archive_unavailable: Ikhathalogu ye-firmware ayifinyeleleki okwesikhatjhana. Usengafaka ukusuka e-archive nofana amafayela wendawo.
single_instance_body: Elinye ikhophi livulekile, nofana lisasebenza ngemuva. Amakhophi amabili azokuncintisana ngokuxhumana kwe-USB yomdlali, njeke lokhu angeze kwathoma.
single_instance_focus_failed: Ikhophi esebenzako azange iphendule isibawo sokutjengisa iwindi layo. Kungenzeka kube matasa namkha kulengiswe. Ukuyitjhiya ngamandla kuzokuphazamisa nanyana yini eyifakako.
single_instance_force_failed: Ikhophi esebenzako ayikwazanga ukuqedwa. Ziyekele ngokwakho, bese uthoma ukuvuselela godu.
single_instance_busy_body: Ikhophi esebenzako ifaka isofthiwe nofana ikhuluma nomdlali, njeke ukuyiqeda nje kungaphazamisa lokho. Ukuhlonywa lokhu kuzokuvalwa; sebenzisa iwindi elikhona nofana isithonjana sayo sebha yemenyu lokha nakuqedwa ukufaka.
notices_summary_body: Vula izaziso kuhlelo lokusebenza ukuze uzifunde.
toast_battery_charged: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa lokhu kumdlali wakho, shaja ibhetri okungenani i-awa
toast_battery_charged_device: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa lokhu kudivayisi yakho, shaja ibhetri okungenani i-awa
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Vumela izaziso zemuva ukwamukela izaziso zokubuyekezwa nokukhipha izexwayiso ngitjho nanyana i-Updater ivaliwe kubha yemenyu.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Vumela izaziso zemuva ukwamukela ukubuyekezwa nokukhipha izexwayiso ngitjho nanyana i-Updater ivaliwe ethreyini yesistimu.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Iinkonzo zokutjhugulula nge-inthanethi njengamanje azifinyeleleki nofana zisesikhathini sokupholisa. Amanothi wokuthoma wokukhipha azokutjengiswa esikhundleni salokho.
translate_unavailable_hint: Ukutjhugulula akutholakali okwesikhatjhana. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho kwe-inthanethi nofana uzame godu ngokukhamba kwesikhathi.
sel_notes_hint: Khetha ukukhutjhwa ukuze ubone itjhuguluko layo
flash_wait_desc: Cima idivayisi qangi. Nangabe ixhunyiwe kodwana ayibonakali, linga ikheyibuli ye-USB ehlukileko nofana i-port.
dialog_pre_install_header: Sibawa wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi i-{model} yakho ivaliwe begodu ayixhunyiwe yi-USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Cima idivayisi yakho ngaphambi kokuthi uqalise.
• Nangabe idivayisi iqhwa namkha ayisabeli, sebenzisa ipini namkha isiqetjhana sephepha emgodini wokusetha kabutjha ukugandelela amandla ukuvala imodi yokudawuniloda.
• Gcina ikheyibuli ye-USB ingaxhunyiwe okwamanje.
• Chofoza Ragela phambili, bese uxhuma idivayisi yakho nge-USB lokha nawubawa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Cima ngokuphelele idivayisi yakho ye-MediaTek.
• Gcina ikheyibuli ye-USB ingaxhunyiwe okwamanje.
• Ngokuya ngemodeli, zama ukuxhuma ngebhetri efakwe namkha ngaphandle kwayo (nofana ubambe iVolumu phasi / phezulu lokha nawuxhumako).
• Chofoza i-Ragela phambili, bese uhlanganisa ikheyibuli ye-USB lokha nawubawa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Asikwazi ukugcina idatha yakho malungana nokufaka lokhu ngombana i-firmware yakho yamanje ayihambisani ne-Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Khupha ikheyibuli ye-USB bese usebenzisa isiqetjhana sephepha nofana ipini ukugandelela ibhathini lokusetha kabutjha, bese uzama ukuxhuma godu.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Kunconywa bona umdlali uhlanganise itjhaja ebodeni imizuzu ema-30 ukuya kweli-awa ngaphambi kokulinga ukuyihlanganisa.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Nawusebenzisa i-Windows, qiniseka bona ufake ama-Driver.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Ama-PC we-Windows kufanele aqaliswe kabutjha ngemva kokufaka umtjhayeli ngaphambi kokusetjenziswa kokuthoma.
keep_data_running_fmt: Ingabe i-{software} sele ifakiwe ku-{model} yakho?
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Ingabe isofthiwe sele ifakiwe ku-{model} yakho?
install_first_which_firmware: Ngiyiphi ihlelo elisebenzako njenganje ku-{model} yakho?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Nawungaqiniseki, khetha 'Okunye' nofana isofthiwe ocabanga bona ifakiwe.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Ukuragela phambili nokufaka lokhu, sibawa uqinisekise bona i-{model} yakho sele isebenzisa isofthiwe etlhogekako ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Singagcina amasethingi wakho nemidiya kwaphela lokha umdlali sele asebenzisa isofthiwe le nofana inguqulo ehambelana nayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Singagcina amasethingi wakho kwaphela lokha umdlali sele asebenzisa isofthiwe le nofana inguqulo ehambelana nayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Singagcina amasethingi wakho nemidiya kwaphela lokha umdlali sele asebenzisa isofthiwe le nofana inguqulo ehambelana nayo.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Vumela ukugcina amasethingi nemidiya kiyo nanyana ngikuphi ukufakwa kwe-firmware
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Yeqa umbuzo wokuhambisana. Sebenzisa lokhu kwaphela lokha nawunesiqiniseko sokuthi umdlali uzakuragela phambili nokusebenza ngamasethingi wakhe wamanje nemidiya.
err_keep_data_failed: Awukghoni ukugcina amasethingi wakho nemidiya: ifolda ye-firmware ayibhaleki. Akukho okufakiweko.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Igcina amasethingi wakho nemidiya emdlalweni. Isofthiwe yoke ifakiwe njengenjwayelo.
flash_keep_data_warning: Nawuragela phambili ngaphandle kwalokhu, amasethingi wakho nemidiya izokusethwa kabutjha esitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Nawuragela phambili ngaphandle kwalokhu, amathimu wakho we-Rockbox, amafonti namasethingi azokususwa. Umculo wakho nezinye iindaba zizokuhlala emdlalweni.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Nawuragela phambili ngaphandle kwalokhu, amathemu wakho we-Rockbox, amafonti namasethingi azokususwa, begodu isitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali sizokusethwa kabutjha.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Nawuragela phambili ngaphandle kwalokhu, amasethingi wakho azokusethwa kabutjha. Umculo wakho nezinye iindaba zizokuhlala emdlalweni.
format_all_data_warning_y1: I-firmware le kufanele ifomethe kabutjha isitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali. Amasethingi alondoloziweko azokususwa; umvumo wakho nezinye iindaba zizokuhlala zikhona.
format_all_data_warning_other: I-firmware le kufanele ifomethe kabutjha isitoreji sangaphakathi somdlali. Amasethingi alondoloziweko nemidiya egcinwe esitorejini esakhelwe ngaphakathi kuzokususwa. Imidiya ku-microSD yakho ihlala endaweni yayo.
format_all_confirm_question: Fometha kabutjha isitoreji sangaphakathi ku-{model} yakho?
format_all_confirm_body:
Nge-{software} kufuze sifomethe kabutjha isitoreji sakho sangaphakathi se-{model} ngaphambi kobana siragele phambili. Bese kuzokulingwa omunye umzamo we-SP Flash Tool, kodwana ku-Format All + Download mode nge-XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Khupha i-USB, bese ufaka isiqetjhana sephepha nofana ipini emgodini wokusetha kabutjha ku-{model} yakho. Chofoza okulandelako ukuzama godu ku-Fometha koke + imodi yokudawuniloda.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: I-SP Flash Tool ibike bona itafula lokuhlukanisa lomdlali litjhugulukile (8502). I-firmware le kufanele ifakwe ku-Format All + Download mode, efometha kabutjha isitoreji sangaphakathi.
install_first_hint: Ngaphambi kokusetha i-{target} kokuthoma, i-{model} yakho kufuze bona isebenze i-{software} — nofana i-{target} ngokwayo, nangabe sele ifakiwe begodu isebenza.
install_first_version_fmt: Ingabe i-{model} yakho sele ihlangabezana nesidingo se-{software} ({version})?
install_first_power_on_fmt: Sibawa ukhuphe i-USB, uvule i-{model} yakho bese uchofoza Okulandelako.
install_first_power_on_hint: Vumela umdlali athome kanye ku-firmware yesisekelo, bese uyivala ukuze ufake okulandelako.
install_first_need_body: {software} yihlelo eliyisisekelo le-{target}. Izokufakwa ku-{model} yakho kokuthoma, bese {target} ilandela ngokuzenzakalelako.

support_story_1_headline: Lokha abakhiqizi nabaragela phambili, umphakathi uyakhuphuka.
support_story_1_lead: Ukuvikela idivayisi yakho eencupheni ezithulileko ze-hardware kanye nokubuyekezwa okuphukileko.
support_story_1_body: I-Innioasis ihlala ikhipha ama-firmware amatjha wabadlali abafana ne-Y1 (okuqothe ukubuyekezwa kwebhodi efihlekileko njenge-6.0, 7.0, kanye ne-8.0) ephula amadivayisi amadala ngokuthula. Okumbi khulu, iwebhusayithi yabo ayinikeli iinyeleliso ezingekho begodu ayikho ukufinyelela kuma-firmware asebenzako ngaphambilini ukululama ebujameni obuqinileko. I-Updater kanye nephrojekthi ye-Community Firmware ithatha izinto: sigcina yoke i-ROM yesitokwe esidala, siqinisekisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ukubuyekezwa kwe-hardware yakho, begodu sigcine umdlali wakho usebenza ngokuphepha.
support_story_1_item_1: Ukusindisa abadlali abaphukileko: Ukuhlolwa kokuphepha kuqinisekisa bona ukubuyekezwa okutjha akusoze kuvimbele i-hardware endala.
support_story_1_item_2: Ama-ROM we-Stock agcinweko: Iqoqo elipheleleko lama-firmware wefektri we-Innioasis asusiwe.
support_story_1_item_3: I-Native Cross-Platform: Amathulusi wokukhanya apheleleko we-macOS, i-Linux, ne-Windows ngokufanako.
support_story_1_item_4: Ubuhlakani be-Hardware: Ukutholwa kwebhodi okuzenzakalelako ukwenzela bona uhlale ufumana iphakheji efaneleko.
support_story_2_headline: Awekho amadrayivu we-Google aphukileko. Akukho ukuqagela. I-firmware esebenzako.
support_story_2_lead: Umthangalasiseko womphakathi onejubane elikhulu, oqinisekisiweko ongathembela kiwo.
support_story_2_body: Ukulandelela isofthiwe ye-Innioasis esemthethweni kuvamise ukutjho ukuhlolisisa amaforamu malungana nama-link we-Google Drive aphelelwe sikhathi, ama-Baidu cloud shares afileko, kanye namafayela we-zip angaziwako angenawo amathulusi wokukhanya. Sakhe inethiwekhi yokudawuniloda ethembekileko, ezijameleko ene-SHA-256 eqinisekisiweko, izaziso zokuvuselela, kanye nokufakwa okuqondiswa ngesinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Iminikelo yakho igcina ngqo ukulandwa nokusingatha okwenza lokhu kwenzeke ama-awa ama-24 ngelanga, amalanga ama-365 ngomnyaka.
support_story_2_item_1: I-CDN eqondileko enejubane elikhulu: Ukudawuniloda okurhabako, okuqondileko ngaphandle kwemikhawulo yokudawuniloda nofana amalinki afileko.
support_story_2_item_2: Izaziso zokuvuselela: Thola isiyeleliso ngesikhatjhana umphakathi omutjha ukhutjhwe namkha ukulungiswa kwehlile.
support_story_2_item_3: Ukufakwa okuqondiswako ngokulandelana: Iinthombe ezibonakalako ezikhanyako zikukhambisa ngaso soke isikhathi sokugandelela ibhathini.
support_story_2_item_4: Umphakathi okhuluma amalimi amanengi: Okupheleleko ngesiNgisi, isiTjhayina, isiJarimani, isiSpanishi, isiFrentshi nesiJapan.
support_story_3_headline: Ukuvula amandla woke womdlali wakho we-Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Ukuletha i-Rockbox, amasistimu wokusebenza alula, kanye nekululeko yabantu abathanda ukulalela.
support_story_3_body: Isofthiwe yefemu yesitokwe ikhuhla kwaphela lokho okungenziwa yi-Y1 nofana ye-Y2 hardware yakho. Umphakathi wethu ulethe i-Rockbox, amasistimu wokusebenza alula, ukudlala i-codec ye-audiophile, kanye neengqikithi ezikhethekileko. Sithenga ukuhlukahluka kwe-hardware ebonakalako ngaphandle kwephakethe ukuhlola, ukubuyisela emuva, nokuqinisekisa koke ukufakwa. Ukusekela i-Updater kusekela ngokunqophileko amayunithi wokuhlola la begodu kurhabisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-firmware eyenziwe ngokwezifiso.
support_story_3_item_1: I-Rockbox yokuchofoza kanye: Ukudlala kwe-audiophile kanye neengqikithi ezikhethekileko ezifakwe ngemizuzwana.
support_story_3_item_2: Ihlelo lomphakathi: Ukuthuthukiswa kwebhetri, i-UI ehlanzekileko, kanye nokusekelwa kwe-audio codec yesimanjemanje.
support_story_3_item_3: I-Active Hardware Lab: Sihlola kumadivayisi wamambala ngaphambi kokukhipha nanyana ngikuphi ukwakha.
support_story_3_item_4: I-Zero Bloatware: i-100% yamahhala, isofthiwe yokuqala ubumfihlo ngaphandle kwemikhangiso noma ukulandelela.
support_story_4_lead: Ukulondolozwa kwe-firmware okwenziwa mphakathi kugcina amadivayisi wakho ngaphandle kwendawo yokulahla imfucuza.
support_story_4_body: Lokha ikhamphani ye-hardware nayidlulela kugajethi yayo elandelako, amamodeli amadala ayalahlwa. I-Innioasis ayinikeli isekelo le-Linux, ayikho amatjhuguluko abonakalako, begodu ayikho indlela elula yokubuyisa lokha nakubhalelwa ukufakwa. I-CE yokuvuselela ikhona ngombana abasebenzisi abanethando akukafaneli balahle isidlali somvumo esihle khulu. I-100% yeminikelo yomphakathi iya ngqo ekugcineni ithulusi leli livulekele woke umuntu.
support_story_4_item_1: Ukuhlangula nokuvula: Ukubuyiselwa okufakazelweko kuyageleza ngitjho nanyana amadivayisi ala ukuqalisa.
support_story_4_item_2: I-Linux First-Class Support: I-MediaTek esekelwa ngokuzeleko ekhanyako kuma-distros we-Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Amalogi wokutjhuguluka abonakalako: Amanothi wokukhipha anemininingwana ukwenzela bona wazi kuhle bona ngiziphi iintjhuguluko.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Imali Yomphakathi: Ikofi ngayinye igcina indawo yokubulunga ivulekile begodu ikhululekile kibo boke abantu.
support_methods_subtitle: Khetha indlela oyithandako yokufaka isandla. Iminikelo ngayinye ibhadela ngokunqophileko ukudawuniloda, ukusingatha, nokuhlolwa kwe-hardware.
update_install_win: Landa i-{hint} bese uyisebenzisa. Umfakisi uthatha indawo yenguqulo yamanje; amasethingi wakho kanye ne-firmware elandiweko igcinwe.
update_install_mac: Landa i-{hint}, uyivule, bese udosa i-app uyifake kufolda yakho yama-Applations.
update_install_linux: Landa i-{hint}, yenza bona isebenze, bese uyisebenzisa, ithatha indawo yenguqulo yangaphambilini.
update_install_generic: Landa i-{hint} ekhasini lokukhipha bese ulandela imiyalo yokufaka yesistimu yakho.
update_check_failed: Angeze sakwazi ukuhlola ukubuyekezwa kwanje. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese uzama godu.
settings_drivers_gate_body: Ukufaka iintjhayeli ze-USB ze-MediaTek kuthatha isikhathi sinye, begodu i-Windows iyazithatha ngemva kokuqalisa kabutjha. Bekube kulapho kokubili sele kwenziwe, i-app ingahle ingatholi umdlali wakho lokha nakuthoma ukufakwa.
settings_reminders_desc: Sizokwazisa lokha nakukhutjhwa inguqulo etja yesofthiwe yomdlali wakho.
settings_reminders_desc_in_app: Sizokwazisa kuhlelo lokusebenza lokha iinbuyekezo nofana izaziso zomphakathi nazitholakala kubadlali bakho.
settings_reminders_desc_bg_menu_bar: Sizokwazisa ngezaziso zesistimu ngitjho nanyana sivaliwe kubha yemenyu lokha iinbuyekezo nofana izaziso zomphakathi zitholakala kubadlali bakho.
settings_reminders_desc_bg_system_tray: Sizokwazisa ngezaziso zesistimu ngitjho nanyana sivaliwe ethreyini yesistimu lokha iindaba ezibuyekeziweko nofana izaziso zomphakathi zitholakala kubadlali bakho.
settings_not_installed: Akukho ukufakwa okurekhodiweko okwanje (kulondolozwa ngokuzenzakalelako ngemva kokukhanya)
settings_firmware_up_to_date: Woke amadivayisi alandelelwako asebenzisa ukukhishwa kwe-firmware yakamuva!
settings_no_devices_tracked: Akukho ukufakwa kwedivayisi okurekhodiweko okwanje. Flash idivayisi ukuvumela ukulandelela inguqulo.
settings_hide_donations_tip: Vala ukufihla amakhredithi kanye namacebo wokunikela ukuze ubukeke kuhle.
settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Tjengisa imininingwana elula yokuqeda ngaphandle kokubawa iminikelo ngemva kokukhanya.
settings_cache_desc: Susa amaphakheji we-firmware alandiweko kanye namafayela we-ROM akhutjhiweko ukukhulula isikhala sediski. Umlando wakho wokufaka kanye nokukhetha kwesikhumbuzo sokubuyekeza kuyalondolozwa.
retry_guidance_intro: Ukuxhumana kwe-USB kumdlali wakho akusaphenduli. Umdlali wakho udinga ukusetha kabutjha ngesandla ngaphambi kokuthi omunye umzamo usebenze.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Cindezela inkinobho yokusetha kabutjha efihlekileko ngephini, isiqetjhana sephepha nofana icici.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Faka ikheyibuli ye-USB godu, bese uzama godu.

onboarding_after_add_footer:
Ukwazi bona idivayisi yakho inayiphi isofthiwe kuqinisekisa bona ukufakwa kwenziwa kuhle kiyo yoke isofthiwe etholakala kuhlelo lokusebenza.

Nawuqedile ukufaka amadivayisi, vele uchofoze uKwenziwe ukuthoma ukusebenzisa i-Updater.
onboarding_body: Sitjele bona ngiliphi isofthiwe umdlali ngamunye asebenzisako, begodu sizokwazisa lokha nasele kuphumile amasethingi wakho, sigcine amasethingi wakho aphephile begodu sisize nangabe ukufakwa kungakhambi kuhle. Faka umdlali wakho nje ukwenzela bona koke lokho kuthome ukusebenza kusukela ekufakweni kokuthoma.

sel_install_tooltip: Faka isofthiwe yohlelo olukhethiweko ku-{lbl} yakho
mtk_da_required: Khetha i-Agent yokudawuniloda ngaphambi kokuthi uthome ukufaka.
sel_type_help_tooltip: Linga isofthiwe yesistimu yomhlobo we-A kokuthoma. Nangabe isondo lakho lokuskrola aliphenduli ngemva kokufaka, faka enye yeenkhetho zohlobo B. Amadivayisi we-Type B ngilawo eza neenguqulo ze-firmware ngaphambi kwe-2.0.

• Nangabe ingakavali, cima i-{label} yakho.
• Nangabe ixhunywe ku-USB, yivale qangi.

Bese uhlanganisa ikheyibuli ye-USB ukuthoma ukukhanya.

dl_resuming_fmt: Ukuragela phambili nokudawuniloda kusuka ku-{mb} MB...
linux_engine_staged_desc: I-MediaTek SP Flash Tool ehlelwe nge-libpng12 ukuhambisana.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Chofoza Hlola kabutjha nofana uqalise kabutjha ukusetha ukudawuniloda iphakheji.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Imithetho ye-MediaTek isebenza (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Ukufikelela ideskithophu kuvunyelwe.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Nikela ngeemvumo kanye ukwenzela bona i-app ikghone ukukhulumisana nedivayisi yakho.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Iimvume ze-USB nemithetho ye-udev ifakwe ngepumelelo. Imisebenzi ihlelwe.
donate_rely_on_you: Sisize ngeendleko zethu zokusebenza, nikela namhlanjesi.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Vula i-MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: I-app ibuyiselwe kabutjha ngokupheleleko, isilondolozi sokudawuniloda sisusiwe, begodu isikhumbuzo sebhetri sibuyiselwe emuva.
log_app_reset_defaults: Ukuhleleka kwe-app kubuyiselwe emuva ngokupheleleko, isilondolozi sokudawuniloda sisusiwe, begodu isikhumbuzo sebhetri sibuyiselwe (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ulindele umdlali wakho bona athome godu...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Yigcine ixhunyiwe, i-Rockbox iyathoma begodu iingqikithi zayo zizokufakwa ngokuzenzakalelako.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Hlola bona ifakiwe begodu ivuliwe. Nayikuthi ihlala imnyama, tjhayela ipini emgodini wokusetha kabutjha bese ubamba ibhathini eliphakathi (Y1) nofana ibhathini yamandla (abanye abadlali) ukuyiqalisa godu. Nayikuthi ingakathomi, i-firmware ayizange ithathe, faka enye.
action_flash_complete: I-Flash iphelile! Khupha i-USB bese uqalisa kabutjha.
action_recover_powercycle: Phezulula amandla umdlali (bamba amandla ~10s), bese uyihlanganisa godu - uzama godu...
action_wait_mtk: Silindele idivayisi ye-MTK... Cima idivayisi bese uhlanganisa i-USB.
action_da_stall: Idivayisi yeke ukuphendula lokha nayihlela i-ejenti yokudawuniloda. Yicime ngokupheleleko, uxhuma godu, bese uzama godu.
action_detected_brom: Idivayisi itholakele (imodi ye-BROM) - ukuhlela i-ejenti yokudawuniloda...
action_detected_preloader: Idivayisi itholakele (imodi yokulayisha ngaphambilini) - ukuhlela i-ejenti yokudawuniloda...
action_da_wait_back: Umdlali walisa ukuphendula ngesikhathi athoma i-ejenti yokudawuniloda. Ngilindele bona ibuye...
log_install_writing: Faka ekurageleni phambili - ukutlola iinthombe ze-firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Isithombe esincani se-Android esitholiweko se-{part}, sitjhugulula ngesikhathi senqubo...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Ukuqinisekiswa kwetafula lokuhlukanisa kwehlulekile ngemva kokutlola
err_sp_wrong_model: Uhlanganise imodeli engakalungi yomdlali. Tlika ibhathini le-× ukukhansela ukufaka lokhu, bese ukhetha isofthiwe yomdlali oyixhumanileko.
err_sp_timeout: Ithulusi azange libone umdlali. Yigcine ivaliwe begodu ikhutjhwe, bese uhlanganisa ikheyibuli ye-USB lokha nayicelwako.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Umdlali wavula amandla kusesenesikhathi. Yicime ngokupheleleko, bese uyihlanganisa godu.
err_sp_download_fail: Ukutlola kwaphazamiseka. Hlola ikheyibuli ye-USB ne-port kanye nokutjhaja kwebhetri, bese uzama godu.
err_sp_da_init_sync: I-ejenti yokudawuniloda ayikwazanga ukuthoma. Linga enye indlela yokukhanya.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: I-ejenti yokudawuniloda ayikwazanga ukuthunyelwa kumdlali. Yicime bese uyihlanganisa godu.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Umdlali wala i-ejenti yokudawuniloda (iphutha 6104). Sebenzisa i-Download Agent ehlanganiswe ne-SP Flash Tool, bese uhlola bona i-firmware iyafana na nomdlali lo.
err_sp_com_port: Ithuluzi alikwazanga ukuvula i-port yalo ye-serial. Vala amanye amathulusi aphazimako bese uhlanganisa godu.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: I-USB COM port ayikwazanga ukuvulwa (iphutha 1013). Ukuqalisa kabutjha ikhomphyutha yakho kuzokukhulula i-port evaliweko. Sibawa uqalise kabutjha ikhomphyutha yakho bese uzama godu.
err_sp_enable_dram: Ithuluzi alikwazanga ukuthoma imemori yomdlali. Sebenzisa iphakheji eyakhelwe imodeli le.
err_sp_storage_read: Ithuluzi belingakghoni ukufunda isitoreji somdlali. Hlola ukuhlobana; idivayisi ingaba nephutha le-hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Ithulusi eliphazimako alizange litjengise ithuthuko ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana engu-{seconds}, ngalokho umzamo lo wamiswa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Angeze kwakghona ukwakha ukuhlobana okuqinileko nomdlali. Qinisekisa bona idivayisi ivaliwe (sebenzisa ipini ukugandelela inkinobho yokusetha kabutjha nangabe kuyatlhogeka), khipha i-USB, bese uyihlanganisa godu lokha nawubawa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ukukhanya kwaphazanyiswa nofana ukutlola kwehlulekile. Hlola bona ikheyibuli ye-USB ifakwe kuhle begodu ibhetri inetjhaji eyaneleko, bese uzama godu.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: The flashing tool has shown the same line for the last {seconds} seconds and does not appear to be continuing to write the firmware. The flash may have failed. If this was the last of two attempts with each method on a system that can fall back between them, or if only MTKClient is available on this machine, restart the computer and try again.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: I-MTKClient kwaphela etholakalako malungana nokufaka lokhu. Kungenzeka bona i-flash yehlulekile. Sibawa uqalise kabutjha ikhomphyutha bese uzama godu.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Ikhomphyutha le ingafakwa ngokusebenzisa i-SP Flash Tool. Nawungakghona, tjhugulukela ku-SP Flash Tool bese uzama godu.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Kungenzeka bona i-flash yehlulekile. Sibawa ufunde umlayezo ongehla bese uqalisa kabutjha ikhomphyutha ngaphambi kobana uzame godu. Nawuqhafaza ku-OK, i-app izokujama ukwenzela bona ukwazi ukuthoma kabutjha.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Iphakheji ye-firmware ayikho ifayela lokusakaza nofana amafayela wesithombe atlhogekako. Sibawa udawunilode kabutjha iphakheji nofana ukhethe ifayela elipheleleko le-firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Ifayela lokuqinisekisa olikhethileko alikho, alinalitho nofana alikghoni ukutlolwa. Khetha ifayela elivumelekileko, nofana ulisuse kumaSethingi, bese ukhanyisa godu.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ithuluzi lokukhanya namkha abatjhayeli besistimu abatlhogekako bebangakghoni ukuthonywa. Sibawa uhlole iimvume zesistimu, ukusetha umtjhayeli, nofana ufake kabutjha ihlelo.
err_driver_missing_desc: Iphutha leli lingenzeka lokha umtjhayeli we-MediaTek USB ungafakiwe. Chofoza i-Download Drivers ukufaka i-MediaTek USB driver, uqalise kabutjha ikhomphyutha yakho, bese uzama godu.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Ifayela le-firmware elilondoloziweko alikho. Khetha Khetha Isofthiwe ukwakha kabutjha amafayela akhutjhweko nofana ukudawuniloda i-archive ye-firmware godu. Lokhu mraro wefayela lendawo, ingasi umraro wokuthintana kwe-USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Buyela ku-Khetha isofthiwe ukwakha kabutjha nofana ukudawuniloda iphakheji ye-firmware.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kwenzeke iphutha elingakalindelwa ngesikhathi sokufaka ({detail}). Cima umdlali ngokupheleleko, uxhuma godu lokha nawubawa, bese uzama godu.
flash_method_confirm: Indlela yokufaka itjhugululwe yaba {method}. Qinisekisa bona umdlali ukhishiwe begodu uvaliwe, bese uqhafaza okulandelako.
flash_failover_note: {method} azange ithome ukufaka. Ngemva kobana umdlali acinywe begodu akhutjhwe, {other} izokusetjenziswa esikhundleni salokho.
themepack_card_desc: Ifaka hlangana imimongo emihle yomphakathi, iinthombe ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kanye namafonti enziwe ngqo ukubonisa i-360p.
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Vulela umdlali wakho ngokubamba inkinobho yamandla.
2. Lokha i-Rockbox nayiqalisako, faka ikheyibuli ye-USB ekhomphyutheni yakho.
3. Nawucelwa esikrinini somdlali, qinisekisa imodi ye-USB Storage ukwenzela bona idivayisi ivele njengedrayivu.
themepack_step2_title: Igadango 2: Khetha nanyana ngiyiphi ifolda kumdlali
themepack_step2_desc: Ngombana iinhlelo zokusebenza (ezifana ne-macOS) zifihla amafayela we-dot (njenge-.rockbox) ngokuzenzakalelayo, ungakhetha NANYANA NGIPHI ifolda nofana umsuka wedrayivu kumdlali wakho. Sizokufumana ngokuzenzakalelako nofana sikwenzele umtlolo we-.rockbox.
themepack_complete: Iphakheji yommongo ifakwe ngepumelelo! Nje-ke ungavala umdlali wakho ngokuphepha bese ukhetha ummongo ku-Rockbox (Amasethingi > Amasethingi wommongo).
themepack_err_not_found: Akukghoni ukuthola nofana ukuqalisa umkhombandlela we-.rockbox kudrayivu ekhethiweko. Sibawa uqinisekise bona ukhethe ifolda kumdlali wakho.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Igadango 1: Qalisa kabutjha umdlali bese uhlanganisa godu
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Khupha ikheyibuli ye-USB.
2. Vulela umdlali godu bese uyivumela bona iqale i-Rockbox.
3. Lokha i-Rockbox nayisebenzako, hlanganisa ikheyibuli ye-USB, bese ucindezela i-Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: I-app iqala ukuxhumana kwe-ADB (kufikela emizuzwaneni ema-30). Nangabe idivayisi itholakala, amathimu ayadluliselwa begodu umdlali uqalisa kabutjha ngokuzenzakalelako. Ngaphandle kwalokho, yeqa uye ku-USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Akukho sisetjenziswa se-ADB esitholwe ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana ema-30; ukuragela phambili nge-USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Alikho i-ADB binary etholakala kuhlelo lokusebenza; ukuragela phambili nge-USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Ukudluliselwa kwe-ADB kwehlulekile; ukubuyela emuva ku-USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Vumela i-USB Storage Mode kumdlali ukwenzela bona ibonakale njengedrayivu.

3. I-app ihlanganisa iingqikithi ze-360p namafonti, itlola phezu kwamafayela anamagama afanako.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Nje-ke ungavala umdlali ngokuphepha bese ukhetha ummongo ku-Rockbox (Amasethingi > Amasethingi wommongo).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Isofthiwe yakho etja ifakiwe, kodwana ifolda endala ye-.rockbox ayikwazanga ukususwa. Susa ifolda ye-.rockbox kumdlali ngesandla nangabe ufuna ukuthoma kuhle.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Abadlali abangaphezu koyedwa baxhumene. Khupha ezinye bese utjhiya kwaphela leyo efakiweko.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Umdlali utholakele. Ukubeka imimongo yomphakathi namafonti...
